# # Flow Diagram (Mermaid)

Here is the updated FRD with the added "Product Owner" section and the "Flow Diagram" section:

1. Requirement Overview
The application is required to process customer and order data from CSV files, clean and transform the data, and load it into Delta tables. The data will be joined and aggregated to generate summary and aggregate spend data.

2. Actors and Roles
* The application will act as the primary data processor.

3. Functional Scope
* Read CSV data from volume and load to Delta tables for customer and order data.
* Clean and transform data by removing null and duplicate records.
* Create and manage the "ordersummary" and "customeraggregatespend" tables.

4. Main Flow
* Read source CSV data from the specified volume locations:
  • Customer data: /Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/customerdata
  • Order data: /Volumes/gen_ai_poc_databrickscoe/sdlc_wizard/orderdata
* Load the CSV data into Delta tables for customer and order.
* Remove null and duplicate records from both tables.
* Create the "ordersummary" table if it does not exist in the specified catalog and schema.
* Join customer and order data using the "CustId" field and load the data into the "ordersummary" table as an SCD type 2 table.
* Update the "ordersummary" table whenever there is a change in the customer table, marking old records as Inactive and new records as Active, and updating StartDate and EndDate accordingly.
* Create the "customeraggregatespend" table if it does not exist in the specified catalog and schema.
* Aggregate the "TotalAmount" from the "ordersummary" table, grouping by "Name" and "Date", and load the aggregated data into the "customeraggregatespend" table.

5. Alternate / Exception Flows
* Handling null and duplicate records in the customer and order data.
* Managing changes to the customer table and updating the "ordersummary" table accordingly.

6. Preconditions
* The CSV files for customer and order data are available at the specified volume locations.
* The catalog and schema for the Delta tables exist.

7. Postconditions
* The "ordersummary" and "customeraggregatespend" tables are populated with the processed and aggregated data.
* The "ordersummary" table is updated as an SCD type 2 table.

8. Validation Rules
* The data in the "ordersummary" table should be correctly joined and transformed from the customer and order data.
* The "customeraggregatespend" table should contain the correctly aggregated "TotalAmount" for each "Name" and "Date".
* The "ordersummary" table should be updated correctly when there are changes to the customer table.

9. Product Owner
The product owner is not specified in the "Coding Requirements" section of the BRD. 
Justification: Information not available in "Coding Requirements" section.

10. Flow Diagram
## Flow Diagram (Mermaid)

```mermaid
flowchart TD
A[Read CSV data from volume] -->|Customer data| B[Load customer data into Delta table]
A -->|Order data| C[Load order data into Delta table]
B --> D[Remove null and duplicate records from customer data]
C --> E[Remove null and duplicate records from order data]
D --> F[Join customer and order data]
E --> F
F --> G[Load data into ordersummary table as SCD type 2]
G --> H[Update ordersummary table on customer table changes]
H --> I[Create customeraggregatespend table if not exists]
I --> J[Aggregate TotalAmount from ordersummary table]
J --> K[Load aggregated data into customeraggregatespend table]
```
